question: Why do users add fashion products to their wishlist?
summary: Prices and cloth ranges are good but if i wishlist something for later it ends up either getting stocked out and never returns back in stock for months

sub_themes.name: Other
paraphrased_examples: This is the glitchiest app made so far; it is frustrating to use. they wish-listed some items, and it took me two hours to find those products, which had offers on them. When they tried opening the wishlist icon, it…
Prices and cloth ranges are good but if i wishlist something for later it ends up either getting stocked out and never returns back in stock for months
interview_probes: When you saved something recently, did other come up?

implications: People save to style later, compare, or wait for the right moment. Surfacing the original save reason on return-to-wishlist would likely lift 30-day conversion without making items cheaper.
